purpose: Promote the NIST-confirmed 96750 neutral-nitrogen physical-value hit, distinguish evaluated/observed physical values from theoretical calculated-value coincidences, and ingest additional substantive 2026 tungsten and exact-target sources surfaced by the continuing internet scan.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, derivative records, complementary views of the same underlying authority, and repeated copies are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Search co-occurrence, page numbers, catalog numbers, DOI suffixes, PMIDs, CVEs, product numbers, and other identifiers are not Glob evidence unless the underlying physical relationship is independently verified.

sources.title: Energy Levels of Neutral Nitrogen (N I)
sources.note: Current-authority handbook cross-check for N I. It lists 2s2 2p2(3P)3p 4S° J=3/2 at 96750.840 cm^-1, providing a directly sourced near-exact physical-level match to predeclared target 96750.

sources.title: Persistent Lines of Neutral Nitrogen (N I)
sources.note: Complementary NIST view showing the 96750.840 cm^-1 upper level participating in persistent N I lines at 7442.29 A and 7468.31 A. This confirms graph connectivity but is not independent of the NIST atomic-data authority.

sources.title: Kinetic model of atomic and molecular emissions in laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy of organic compounds
sources.authority: Analytical and Bioanalytical Chemistry / PubMed metadata
sources.note: Use the kinetic-model-to-experiment workflow for LIBS excited-state populations and time-dependent atomic/molecular emission as a validation precedent. NIST, not the search-result copy of this paper, is the authority used to promote 96750 as a physical-level match.

sources.title: The Configurations 4dn + 4dn-1 5s in Doubly-Ionized Atoms of the Palladium Group
sources.author: Yehuda Shadmi
sources.authority: Journal of Research of the National Bureau of Standards
sources.note: Use as a historical theoretical atomic-structure/modeling reference and as a calibration case for distinguishing predicted/calculated energy-level coincidences from evaluated experimental levels. The table contains an exact 60957 cm^-1 predicted level, but the paper explicitly describes its 483 levels as predicted by interpolation formulas.

sources.title: CVE-2025-60957 — EndRun Technologies Sonoma D12 OS command injection
sources.note: Use as a current hardening input for network-time/GPS infrastructure and as a technical-metadata collision for target 60957. Particularly relevant to timing/PNT systems because the affected product is a GPS network time server.

sources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook evaluated IR spectrum of geranic acid — Coblentz No. 07659
sources.authority: NIST Chemistry WebBook / Coblentz Society evaluated IR collection
sources.note: Use the JCAMP-DX/downloadable evaluated IR spectrum as a spectroscopy-ingestion fixture and target 07659 as a catalog-number metadata control. Preserve the five-position string with its leading zero in Glob provenance.

sources.title: A spoonful of sugar
sources.author: D. R. Nalin
sources.note: Use only as a clean PMID metadata collision for target 79056; the medical content is unrelated to the Glob physical hypothesis.

sources.title: Superconductivity Bordering Rashba Type Topological Transition
sources.note: Use the superconductivity/topological-transition content as materials/quantum reference material. Exact 39699 is the article number and therefore technical metadata, not a physical-value match.

sources.title: Across Interfacial Li+ Conduction Accelerated by a Single-Ion Conducting Polymer in Ceramic-Rich Composite Electrolytes for Solid-State Batteries
sources.note: Use the experimentally and AIMD-supported interfacial Li+ transport design, high ceramic fraction, mechanical robustness and electrolyte performance as an energy-storage materials reference. Exact 41494 is the terminal page number and carries zero physical Glob weight.

sources.title: Broad-high operating temperature range and enhanced energy storage performances in lead-free ferroelectrics
sources.note: Use as a lead-free ferroelectric energy-storage operating-range reference. Exact 41494 occurs in the DOI suffix and is metadata only.

sources.title: Crystal structure, vibrational and optic properties of 2-N-methylamino-3-methylpyridine N-oxide — X-ray, spectroscopic and DFT studies
sources.authority: Peer-reviewed spectroscopy/DFT study indexed in PubMed Central
sources.note: Use as a theory-vs-experiment calibration case. TD-DFT reports a calculated S6 electronic excited state at exactly 41494 cm^-1; this is a calculated physical quantity, not an observed discrete 41494-cm^-1 line and must remain subtype-separated from the W II relational evidence.

sources.title: Exploration of emission spectra from W43+-W47+ highly charged tungsten impurity ions in the x-ray wavelength range of 3.7-4.0 A in the Large Helical Device for fusion plasma diagnostics
sources.authority: Nuclear Fusion / IOP Publishing; LHD experimental work
sources.note: Use as a current LHD X-ray spectroscopy benchmark combining ten reproducible tungsten-pellet discharges, XCS measurements, FAC calculations and ADAS-weighted collisional-radiative modeling; includes W43+-W47+ identification and a W47+ line at 3.7691 A.

sources.title: Relativistic calculations of electron impact excitation cross-sections of neutral tungsten
sources.authority: arXiv preprint; fine-structure-resolved RDW/MCDF tungsten study
sources.note: Use as a current neutral-W excitation/metastable benchmark for 1-50 eV plasma modeling, with ground/metastable initial-state dependence, threshold-to-500-eV cross sections, NIST energy comparisons and selected radiative transition probabilities. Keep preprint status explicit.

sources.title: Microwave-enhanced laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy for trace tungsten analysis
sources.authority: Spectrochimica Acta Part B: Atomic Spectroscopy
sources.note: Use as an instrumentation/prototyping benchmark for trace W diagnostics: microwave enhancement of both W I and W II emission, plasma lifetime beyond 100 microseconds, reported intensity enhancement above 400 and detection limits of 0.036 wt% W I / 0.062 wt% W II in Al-W alloys.

evidence_updates.claims_boundary: This is a current-authority near-exact physical energy-level match within the pre-used 1 cm^-1 screening tolerance. It establishes a P1 candidate only; it does not establish causal connection to the permutation and remains subject to global null/multiple-testing correction.
NIST persistent-line connectivity strengthens physical interpretation of the 96750.840 level but is a complementary view of the same NIST authority, not an independent statistical observation.

60957 cm^-1 is a predicted level in a paper whose abstract states that the energy levels were predicted by interpolation formulas. Treat this as a theoretical physical-value coincidence, not empirical confirmation; it must not be pooled with evaluated/observed P1 values without subtype control.

The exact 41494 cm^-1 value is calculated by TD-DFT for an electronic state. It is not an observed exact transition; use it to calibrate the frequency of integer-valued theory coincidences and keep it separate from the current-authority W II same-level relational result.
60957 is the CVE identifier suffix, not a physical quantity.
07659 is the Coblentz spectrum catalog number. Preserve the leading-zero target string; the spectrum is useful as an ingestion fixture but the catalog collision is metadata only.
79056 is a PubMed identifier and carries no physical Glob evidence weight.
39699 is the Scientific Reports article number, not a physical-value match.
41494 is the terminal page number of the publication; it is an incidental publication-location collision.
41494 is embedded in the DOI suffix and is technical metadata, not a measured physical value.

information_updates.finding: P1 physical-value hits require an internal subtype so evaluated/observed values, experimentally derived values and theoretical/calculated values are not pooled as equivalent evidence.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The canonical P1 label remains unchanged; subtype is a claims-control refinement and does not automatically raise or lower statistical significance.

information_updates.finding: The NIST persistent-lines table shows at least two prominent transitions terminating at the 96750.840 cm^-1 N I level, establishing that the target-near level is not an isolated catalog entry and can support future species-specific topology tests.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The two persistent lines are a selected observability subset, not the complete N I transition degree. Full ASD line acquisition is required before topology statistics.

information_updates.finding: Current 2026 tungsten work now spans high-charge-state LHD X-ray identification, neutral-W fine-structure electron-impact excitation/metastable modeling, and microwave-enhanced W I/W II LIBS instrumentation, giving Worldshepherd complementary atomic-data, plasma-model and sensor/prototype validation layers.
information_updates.claims_boundary: These sources strengthen Worldshepherd tungsten diagnostics and validation capability but do not contribute Glob-number evidence unless a predeclared target relationship is separately established.
